text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly down over the last day despite greed sentiment climbing to 71, suggesting traders are holding positions rather than panic-selling even as prices consolidate. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.3% alongside $110B in daily volume indicates steady capital flow to the largest assets, though Solana's 3.3% gain hints at some appetite for alternative L1s. The sharp rise in Fear & Greed over the past week signals growing conviction among traders, though the modest price declines in major pairs suggest this optimism hasn't yet translated into a strong breakout move.
